summary: Broadridge Financial Solutions filed an 8-K reporting the closing of a $500M public offering of 5.750% Senior Notes due 2036, priced at par under an S-3 shelf registration. The notes were issued on May 15, 2026 and pay semiannual interest; the company has optional redemption rights with a make-whole premium before February 15, 2036. This is a standard debt financing, not a special-situation event, as it solely involves capital markets activity without triggering control or structural change. No special-situation classification applies.
